# finishFile stores the current context under a file name; reopening a
# finished file (case-insensitively) continues it; finishing a name twice
# warns on stdout and keeps the file's position; whatever is left at the end
# is finished under the given output file name.
input json TopLevel {"a": 1}

render probe {"filename": "main.out"} script
line ["first file"]
finish "First.txt"
line ["second file"]
blank 1
finish "Second.txt"
reopen "first.TXT"
line ["appended to first"]
finish "first.txt"
line ["second again"]
finish "Second.txt"
reopen "SECOND.txt"
indent 1
line ["indented after reopen"]
finish "Second.txt"
line ["rest"]
end

render probe {"filename": "empty.out"} script
finish "only.txt"
end

render probe {"filename": "nothing.out"} script
end
